name: Reading Hour
summary: A folded bookmark with time at its heart. Quran reading and daily reminders share one compact symbol.
why: A solid bookmark makes the reading connection immediate. A clock is cut into its center, joining the Quran reader and saved reading position to the app's daily rhythm and reminders. Violet and fresh lime give the familiar page a contemporary character.
risk: Reading leads the identity; the mark may also suit an audiobook or reading-habit app.
